diagnosis: The throttle class derives the account subscription tier using an untrusted X-Account-ID request header without verifying whether request.user is a member of that account. Free-tier users can bypass their 60 req/min limit by specifying an Enterprise account ID in the header.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/analytics/realtime/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.datadash.io
Authorization: Bearer <free_user_token>
X-Account-ID: 1009
corrected_code:
from rest_framework.throttling import BaseThrottle
from django.core.cache import cache

class TieredAccountRateThrottle(BaseThrottle):
    def allow_request(self, request, view):
        if not request.user or not request.user.is_authenticated:
            return False
        account = getattr(request.user, 'account', None)
        tier = account.tier if account else 'free'

        limit = 1000 if tier == 'enterprise' else 60
        cache_key = f"rate_user_{request.user.id}"
        current = cache.get(cache_key, 0)
        if current >= limit:
            return False
        cache.set(cache_key, current + 1, 60)
        return True
